about.versionOfDevDesc: Shift Planner was born out of the daily struggle to balance the infinite logic of programming with academic commitment and university workload. It serves as the digital bridge that protects your habits and daily progress from collapsing amidst context switching and exam stress
about.context-isolation: The separation of context between development and study to avoid mental fatigue
about.sustainability: Focus on sustainable habits instead of just completing tasks
about.native-engine: Smart reminder engine from the heart of the operating system, to bring you back to your path before the end of the day
about.reactNative: ⚛️ Framework: Built entirely with React Native and Expo for smooth, fast performance.
about.zustand: 🐻 State Management: Powered by Zustand Store for real-time data updates without delay.
about.tailwindcss: 🎨 UI Engine: Using Tailwind CSS (NativeWind) for a flexible, consistent, fully responsive design.
about.mmkv: 💾 Local Storage: Using MMKV for ultra-fast local data persistence with exceptional read/write speed.
about.i18next: 🌐 Internationalization: Using i18next for seamless instant translation between Arabic and English.
